name: Sablewood Messengers
description: The ancient, perpetually dim Sablewood — a forest so dense with canopy that travelers can barely tell day from night — and the King's Road that cuts through it, from the court of King Emeris out to Hush, a quiet, hospitable village nestled deep in the trees. Marlowe Fairwind, the King's own elf sorcerer, sends her most trusted allies on missions of the gravest importance along this road — carriages sealed with magic, packages nobody in the capital dares open themselves. Notable landmarks include the Open Vale, a perfect clearing ringed by standing stones where trees refuse to grow, and the strange, shadowed ecosystems the Sablewood's own gloom has bred.
